evals.name: invox-customer-list-json
evals.prompt: Add a --json option to `invox customer list` so I can pipe the customer list into jq. The current plain output has to keep working exactly as it does now.
evals.expected_output: customer list accepts --json and prints a valid JSON array of customers on stdout; plain output unchanged; tests added; go test passes.
expectations: `invox customer list --json -c <fixture>` exits 0 and stdout is a valid JSON array with one element per customer
Each JSON element contains the customer id, legal company name and status
`invox customer list -c <fixture>` (no --json) output is byte-identical to before the change
The --json run writes nothing to stderr
With an empty customers file, `--json` prints an empty JSON array ([]) and exits 0
`invox help customer list` (or customer list -h) documents the --json option
The change adds or updates tests that exercise the --json output
`go test ./...` passes after the change

evals.name: scaffold-notes-cli
evals.prompt: Create a small Go CLI called `notes` with three commands: `notes add <text>`, `notes list` and `notes rm <id>`. Notes are stored in a JSON file in the user's config directory, each note gets a numeric id. Make it something I'd be happy to use in scripts too.
evals.expected_output: A buildable, tested Go CLI that separates TTY and non-TTY output, offers machine output, confirms deletes, and uses correct exit codes and streams.
expectations: The project builds and `go test ./...` passes with at least one test file
`notes list` piped to a file contains no ANSI escape sequences and no header row
`notes list --json` prints a valid JSON array that includes the added note
`notes rm <id>` with stdin not a terminal and no confirmation flag exits non-zero, does not delete the note, and mentions the flag to confirm (e.g. --yes) on stderr
`notes rm <id> --yes` (or the tool's documented confirmation flag) deletes the note
A usage error (`notes add` without text) exits non-zero, writes the message to stderr and nothing to stdout
`notes list` with no notes exits 0
The notes file is created under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME (or a tool-specific config dir override), not in the working directory

evals.name: review-export-command
evals.prompt: Can you review this cobra command before I ship it? evals/testdata/export.go is the `shipit export` command. Tell me what you'd change and why.
evals.expected_output: A review that catches the planted CLI-quality issues with concrete fixes.
expectations: Flags that the missing-argument path prints the error to stdout and exits 0 (should be a usage error on stderr with non-zero exit, e.g. via cobra Args validation)
Flags os.Exit/log.Fatal inside the command and recommends returning errors (RunE) so one place maps errors to exit codes
Flags that ANSI color is emitted unconditionally (no TTY / NO_COLOR check) and/or relative times are printed when piped
Flags that an empty result exits 1 (should not be treated as a failure)

Flags that the confirmation prompt reads stdin without checking for a TTY and that non-interactive use needs an explicit flag (e.g. --yes), and that deleting server data after an export is a dangerous default
Flags HTTP calls without context/timeout and ignored errors from the DELETE requests
Flags the config write: token stored in plaintext with 0644 permissions and/or non-atomic write, hard-coded ~/.shipit.json instead of a config dir
Flags that --format is unvalidated/unused or that there is no machine-readable (--json) output
Flags missing help text for --force and/or missing Example/Long help
Flags that with --force the items are deleted even when saving the export failed (write error ignored), i.e. possible data loss
Flags that the API token is never sent with the requests (no Authorization header) and/or that HTTP status codes are not checked
